package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
	scanner.Split(bufio.ScanWords)

	var n1, n2 int64
	var n int

	scanner.Scan()
	fmt.Sscan(scanner.Text(), &n1)
	scanner.Scan()
	fmt.Sscan(scanner.Text(), &n2)
	scanner.Scan()
	fmt.Sscan(scanner.Text(), &n)

	idx := (n - 1) % 6
	neg := false
	current := n1

	if idx >= 3 {
		neg = true
		idx -= 3
	}

	switch idx {
	case 1:
		current = n2
	case 2:
		current = n2 - n1
	}

	if neg {
		current = -current
	}

	const mod = 1000000007
	result := (current%mod + mod) % mod
	fmt.Println(result)
}
